meaning:
ἀπο-χωρίζω
[in LXX: Eze.43:21 (מִפְקָד)* ;]
to separate, part asunder: pass., Rev.6:14; reflexively, to separate oneself: Act.15:39.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,
The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
